commits.title: Harden releases and cache changelog evidence
commits.before_text: Release builds performed synchronous screenshot setup/capture; dependency locks covered direct packages only; image startup/static assets were not smoke-tested.
commits.after_text: CI overlaps cached capture with validation, hands exact-run decoded evidence to releases, enforces complete hashes and final-container smoke/lint gates, preserves runtime SDK versions, and documents verified GitHub protections.

comparisons.title: Repository change report
comparisons.before_text: Verified file presence, sizes and fingerprints at this change's exact first-parent revision.
comparisons.after_text: Verified file presence, sizes and fingerprints after this exact change. Source code and private configuration are not displayed.
comparisons.capture_note: Packaged report capture, recipe repository-change. Exact Git snapshots; synthetic fixtures; browser scripts/traffic disabled. Repository change report; not a UI screenshot. No source code or live data is displayed.
